tables.title: Past Simple (الماضي البسيط)
rows: I visited the villages on the way.
tables.explanation: يستخدم Past Simple للأحداث التي بدأت وانتهت في وقت محدد في الماضي. الكلمات المفتاحية: yesterday, last, ago, in 1999.
tables.examples: I decided to spend my holidays in Wales last year. / I played football last Monday. / I bought a new car two months ago.

tables.title: Past Progressive (الماضي المستمر)
rows: I was having dinner at the restaurant at 7 o'clock.
He wasn't sleeping when you came home.
tables.explanation: يستخدم Past Progressive للأحداث التي كانت مستمرة في الماضي. يتكون من was/were + V-ing.
tables.examples: While I was cycling, my friends were sitting on the beach. / I was writing an e-mail when the phone rang. / I was preparing dinner while Melanie was working upstairs.

tables.title: الفرق بين Past Simple و Past Progressive
rows: Omar was watching TV when his mother entered.
The girls were studying when Mrs. Brown arrived.
tables.explanation: Past Simple يصف حدثاً مكتملاً، بينما Past Progressive يصف حدثاً كان مستمراً. غالباً ما يستخدمان معاً: Past Progressive للحدث المستمر، و Past Simple للحدث القاطع.
tables.examples: I was watching TV when my mother entered the room. / While she was reading a book, the phone rang. / I was walking down the street when it began to rain.

tables.title: Connectors (أدوات الربط)
rows: While I was cycling, my friends were sitting on the beach.
I was walking down the street when it began to rain.
Sam walked into a cake shop after he had finished his work.
He was sad because he couldn't choose any cake.
tables.explanation: أدوات الربط تربط الجمل وتظهر العلاقة بينها.
tables.examples: While I was cycling, my friends were sitting on the beach. / I was walking down the street when it began to rain. / Sam walked into a cake shop after he had finished his work.

tables.title: Question Formation (تكوين السؤال)
rows: What, Who, Where, When, Why, How, ...
I, you, he, she, it, we, they, ...
tables.explanation: لتحويل أي جملة إلى سؤال، نتبع الخطوات: ١- كلمة السؤال ٢- الفعل المساعد ٣- الفاعل ٤- الفعل الرئيسي ٥- باقي الجملة ثم علامة الاستفهام.
tables.examples:
Who helps you to make the right decision?
Teamwork helps me to make the right decision.

Where did you decide to spend your holidays?
I decided to spend my holidays in Wales.

When did you play football?
I played football last Monday.

What were the cakes like?
The cakes were very delicious.

Why did he go there?
He went there to buy a cake.

When did you make your decision?
I made my decision yesterday.

tables.title: Pronunciation - /ʌ/ (الصوت القصير)
tables.explanation: الصوت /ʌ/ هو صوت قصير مفتوح. يظهر في كلمات مثل: cup, bus, cut, fun, but, summer, truck, trouble.
tables.examples: I drink a cup of tea every morning. / The bus is late today. / Summer is my favourite season.

tables.title: Gerund as Subject (اسم الفاعل كفاعل)
rows: الفعل + ing يعمل كفاعل في الجملة
الفعل + ing يعمل كفاعل في الجملة
Choosing well takes knowledge and skill.
tables.explanation: عندما يأتي الفعل + ing في بداية الجملة، فإنه يعمل كفاعل (Subject) ويأخذ فعلاً مفرداً.
tables.examples: Making a choice is easy. / Choosing well takes knowledge and skill.

tables.title: Collocations (المتلازمات اللفظية)
rows: We make thousands of decisions a day.
Before taking a step, we must try to see where potholes are.
Health officials have tried to raise awareness.
The ability to make a decision and stick to it.
The decision-making tools help you to map out all the possible alternatives.
tables.explanation: المتلازمات اللفظية هي كلمات تأتي معاً بشكل معتاد في اللغة.
tables.examples: We make thousands of decisions a day. / Health officials have tried to raise awareness. / The decision-making tools help you to map out all the possible alternatives.

tables.title: Phrasal Verbs (الأفعال المركبة)
rows: John gave up soda about a month and a half ago.
By cutting out soda, John lost five kg.
map out all the possible alternatives
tables.explanation: الأفعال المركبة هي أفعال تتكون من فعل + حرف جر أو ظرف، ويعطي معنى جديداً.
tables.examples: Make up your mind! / John gave up soda about a month and a half ago. / By cutting out soda, John lost five kg.

tables.title: Past Perfect (الماضي التام)
rows: حدث وقع قبل حدث آخر في الماضي
Sam walked into a cake shop, after he had finished his work.
tables.explanation: يستخدم Past Perfect للتعبير عن حدث وقع وانتهى قبل حدث آخر في الماضي. يتكون من had + V3.
tables.examples: Sam walked into a cake shop, after he had finished his work.

tables.title: Passive Voice (المبني للمجهول)
rows: The cakes were kept in the refrigerators.
tables.explanation: المبني للمجهول يستخدم عندما يكون الفاعل غير معروف أو غير مهم، أو عندما نريد التركيز على المفعول به.
tables.examples: The cakes were kept in the refrigerators.

tables.title: Superlatives (صيغة التفضيل)
rows: the most suitable and delicious cake
tables.explanation: صيغة التفضيل تستخدم للمقارنة بين ثلاثة أشياء أو أكثر. تأتي دائماً مع 'the'.
tables.examples: I should choose the most suitable and delicious cake.

tables.title: Possessive Adjectives (صفات الملكية)
rows: My friends were calling to tell me.
He had a problem with his shoulder.
Thousands of drivers will lose their jobs.
tables.explanation: صفات الملكية تأتي قبل الاسم للدلالة على الملكية. تختلف عن ضمائر الملكية (mine, yours, his...) التي تأتي بدلاً عن الاسم.
tables.examples: He had a problem with his shoulder. / Thousands of drivers will lose their jobs.

tables.title: Conditionals Type 2 (الجمل الشرطية من النوع الثاني)
rows: شيء غير حقيقي أو افتراضي في الحاضر
If the operation was successful, he would be completely cured.
tables.explanation: الجمل الشرطية من النوع الثاني تستخدم للتعبير عن مواقف غير حقيقية أو افتراضية في الحاضر. الشرط في Past Simple والنتيجة في would + V1.
tables.examples: If the operation was successful, he would be completely cured.

tables.title: Adverbs (الظروف) - تحويل Adjective إلى Adverb
rows: He should make his mind quickly.
Earthquakes are extremely difficult to predict.
The chef asked Sam to leave immediately.
If the operation was successful, he would be completely cured.
After the operation, he wasn't able to play permanently.
tables.explanation: الظروف (Adverbs) تصف الأفعال وتأتي غالباً بعد الفعل. معظم الظروف تنتهي بـ -ly وتشتق من الصفات (Adjectives) بإضافة ly.
tables.examples: He should make his mind quickly. / The chef asked Sam to leave immediately. / Earthquakes are extremely difficult to predict. / Sam said sorrowfully.
